description: Six Louisville tree boxes used pressure and temperature observations to assess exfiltration over 121 rainfall events during two years. Each box had a drilled infiltration shaft beneath its planting volume. This resource is provided by U.S. EPA Office of Research and Development (ORD). Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown.
